name: Polar sea ice
summary: Arctic sea ice 1.65M km² and Antarctic 1.61M km² below average
state: On 4 Nov Arctic sea-ice extent was about 1.65 million km² below the 1981–2010 average, fifth-lowest for the date, and Antarctic extent about 1.61 million below, third-lowest (NSIDC). Both are in the Watch band; neither pole is at a record low for the date.
for_you: No direct action needed; low sea ice affects polar ecosystems and longer-term climate.
rubric_hit: Both poles below −1.0M km², no record = Watch
why: Sea ice reflects sunlight and regulates ocean circulation; record lows accelerate warming.
drivers: Air and ocean temperatures, winds, season.

rubric.alert: Either pole at a record low for the calendar date.
rubric.normal: Arctic and Antarctic extent anomalies both above −1.0 million km² vs 1981–2010.
